description: Permanently remove any pending ciphertext using the receipt token. Repeating a burn is safe. Burning cannot recover or revoke ciphertext already revealed. No API key, no account and no sign up: call it directly.

receipt_token.description: The receipt_token returned once at creation. Reads metadata or burns; cannot reveal.

secret_id.description: The secret_id returned at creation; not a credential.

name: burn_one_time_secret
title: Revoke one-time secret ciphertext
